details.description:

Crafted with care, these thick-cut, kettle-cooked potato chips offer a perfect balance of bold and delicate flavours. Discover the difference of Kettle Studio Potato Chips – Himalayan Pink Salt, where every bite is a celebration of refined flavour and exceptional quality.

details.description:
Experience the authentic taste of Kettle-cooked Potato Chips – natural and truly delicious. Each chip is cooked the old-fashioned way, batch by batch, using the freshest ingredients and the finest potatoes to bring you a snack that’s completely real. Thick-cut slices of potato deliver a satisfying crunch, free from gluten and artificial colouring.
